note: Re-judged 2026-09-29. The wrong tags on TestConcurrentDumpsStayAddressedToTheirOwnCollector are gone. rfc7854_session_opening_test.go::TestRFC7854SessionPeerUpOnlyForEstablishedPeers primes a new collector (primeSender) over one Established peer and one peer that exchanged OPENs and sent an UPDATE but never reported Up; it counts Peer Ups per address on the collector's bytes: exactly 1 for the Established peer, 0 for the other, and the first message is the Peer Up. A producer that announced every peer with cached OPENs, or none, goes red.
